limits: This verdict reviews retained evidence; no fresh installation, client invocation, provider run or task comparison was performed.

ECC execution evidence concerns source revision 2b6e839771e53096d8451a213d40dc64ec8acac0, whereas the packet lists dd6ee538aee0f548d4a6b520118f875431fd749e. Behavior at the newer pin was not verified.
Private raw logs and the corrected Codex child's tool trace were not independently inspected; the retained receipt distinguishes returned coordinator reports from direct Claude tool observations.
Exact current model variant and reasoning effort were not exposed.
open_gaps: No matched comparison establishes task-quality improvement, reduced instruction volume or provider-cost savings for the selected set.
ECC installation and Claude discovery do not establish task-triggered loading or successful procedure execution across both native clients.
Official CI evidence covers clean-check inspection; failing-log recovery, repair quality and actual agent invocation remain unqualified.
The official security skill has installation and discovery evidence, without supported findings, safe controls or false-positive measurements.
Reference validation does not establish client-extension compatibility or successful activation.
Canonical project rules and conflict resolution remain project responsibilities; the selected repositories do not independently prove those rules are concise or consistently followed.

overturn_protocol.metric: Compare frozen-label accuracy and instruction-contract compliance, including C4 insufficient and C6 deterministic rejection; record actual discovery/loading, instruction conflicts, loaded input volume and complete provider usage. Literal containment alone is insufficient as the incumbent comparison.

overturn_when: Execute matched native-client arms on blueprints/native-skill-practice/catalog-cases.json, retaining the assertions in blueprints/native-skill-practice/promptfooconfig.yaml. Change the relevant default if a pinned alternative improves frozen-label correctness without instruction conflicts or preserves correctness with lower measured instruction volume and complete provider usage. This fixture can overturn the source-review procedure choice; it cannot qualify CI repair or security finding quality.
why_selected: Select ECC's two named procedures, the focused official OpenAI skills and Agent Skills reference tools as an on-demand set. catalogs/foundation/community-practice-20260920.json records local integration through matching source hashes and native Claude discovery of search-first and iterative-retrieval. catalogs/landscape/native-practice.json records actual native execution of the unchanged CI helper: exit 0 with no failing checks, independently corroborated by five successful checks. blueprints/native-skill-practice/native-receipt.json records selected installation, Claude discovery and successful format checks for the official skills; security task quality remains unqualified. catalogs/foundation/decisions.json records native validation and rendering of one portable skill by skills-ref. These observations support selective procedure delivery and format checking without whole-catalog activation; they do not establish comparative task superiority.
